works.note: Oil on canvas, 73.7 x 92.1 cm (MoMA; the FutureAtrium board and assets/paintings/CREDITS.md:75; collection.json has no size). True size on a keyed pine stretcher, the back open to the glass (the unbleached linen and stretcher show through the stele). Slim gilt frame, the Salon's profile at W 0.060, outer 1.036 x 0.852; its back bears on the stele's west face through clear pads; canvas face x -3.885, 45 mm proud of the glass. Centre 1.380 as built (Elan.swift:32). The sign for the elevator: 'this car goes up to the stars' (collection.json notes).
